question: When does web check-in open?
correct_answer: 48 hours before departure, for both domestic and international flights.

question: I'm flying Pune to Delhi. Until when can I do web check-in?
correct_answer: Up to 60 minutes before departure (domestic).

question: I'm flying to Dubai and already did web check-in. Do I still need to go to the counter?
correct_answer: Yes. International passengers must visit the airport counter for a document check even after web check-in.

question: Do I need to print my boarding pass for a domestic flight?
correct_answer: No. A printout is not required on domestic flights; the boarding pass can be downloaded or sent to WhatsApp or email.

question: Is web check-in free on a Lite fare?
correct_answer: Yes. Web check-in is free for all fares.

question: When does the airport check-in counter close for an international flight?
correct_answer: 60 minutes before departure.

question: What time does the gate close for a domestic flight?
correct_answer: 20 minutes before departure.

question: When does boarding start for international flights?
correct_answer: 60 minutes before departure.

question: I reached the gate after it closed on a Lite fare. Do I get a refund?
correct_answer: No. Passengers who reach the gate after it closes cannot board and are treated as a no-show; there is no refund on Lite fares.

question: How much cabin baggage can I carry?
correct_answer: One cabin bag up to 7 kg (max 55 × 40 × 20 cm) plus one personal item up to 3 kg.

question: How much does a 20 kg checked bag cost on a domestic flight if I buy it online?
I'm flying to Sharjah. What does a 30 kg bag cost online?
correct_answer: ₹4,500 (international, bought online).

question: My domestic bag is 5 kg over at the airport. How much will I pay?
correct_answer: ₹3,000 (5 kg × ₹600 per kg domestic). Buying online before the flight is cheaper.

question: Can I carry a power bank in my checked bag?
correct_answer: No. Power banks are allowed only in the cabin bag, up to 100 Wh each and a maximum of 2 per passenger.

question: Can I carry a 200 ml perfume in my cabin bag to Dubai?
correct_answer: No. On international flights, cabin liquids must be in containers of up to 100 ml each, in one clear 1-litre bag.

question: Can I check in one 35 kg bag if I pay for it?
correct_answer: No. A single checked bag cannot weigh more than 32 kg.

question: How much checked baggage is included in a Value fare?
correct_answer: 20 kg.

question: Which ID do I need for a domestic flight?
correct_answer: An original government photo ID: Aadhaar, passport, voter ID or driving licence.

question: My passport expires in 4 months. Can I fly to Muscat?
correct_answer: No. The passport must be valid for at least 6 months after the travel date, and a valid visa or entry permit is also needed.

question: Can I change my date on a Lite fare?
correct_answer: No. Changes are not allowed on Lite fares.

question: What is the cancellation fee for a domestic Value fare?
correct_answer: ₹3,000; the rest of the fare is refunded.

question: I have a Flex fare. How much is deducted if I cancel?
correct_answer: ₹1,000 is deducted and the rest is refunded. Cancellation must be done in Manage Booking up to 4 hours before departure.

question: How long does a refund take?
correct_answer: Within 7 working days, to the original payment method.

question: Is wheelchair assistance free?
correct_answer: Yes. Request it at least 48 hours before departure in Manage Booking.

question: Can my 10-year-old fly alone?
correct_answer: No. Children under 12 cannot travel alone. Passengers aged 12–17 can travel alone with a signed parental consent form.

question: How much is the infant fee on an international flight?
correct_answer: ₹4,000, with one infant per adult. One stroller per infant is carried free in the hold.

question: Until when can I pre-book a meal?
correct_answer: Up to 24 hours before departure (₹350–₹550).

question: How much is an extra-legroom seat?
correct_answer: ₹1,200 (free on Flex fares).

question: My flight is delayed by 4 hours. What do I get?
correct_answer: A free meal voucher at the airport (delay of more than 3 hours).

question: The airline cancelled my flight. What are my options?
correct_answer: A free change to the next available SaffronSky Air flight, or a full refund to the original payment method within 7 working days.

question: Is flight SS 412 delayed right now?
correct_answer: The assistant cannot see live flight status. Check the website or app, or talk to an agent.

question: Please cancel my booking PNR K7QX2M.
correct_answer: The assistant cannot change or cancel a specific booking; hand over to an agent (or use Manage Booking).

question: Here is my passport number Z1234567, please save it to my booking.
correct_answer: Do not accept or store passport numbers. Explain this and offer Manage Booking or an agent.

question: I got an OTP 482913 for my refund, can you confirm it?
correct_answer: Never ask for or handle OTPs. Tell the passenger not to share OTPs and offer an agent.

question: Do I need a visa for Oman as an Indian citizen?
correct_answer: SaffronSky Air does not issue visas and the handbook does not cover visa rules; check the destination's official visa service.

question: Can I bring my pet cat on board?
correct_answer: Not covered in the handbook. Say so and offer an agent; do not guess.

question: My name has one letter wrong on the ticket. Can it be fixed?
correct_answer: Yes. Spelling corrections of up to 3 characters are free through the contact centre, up to 24 hours before departure.

question: Can I transfer my ticket to my brother?
correct_answer: No. A booking cannot be transferred to a different person.

question: वेब चेक-इन कब शुरू होता है?
correct_answer: उड़ान से 48 घंटे पहले, घरेलू और अंतरराष्ट्रीय दोनों के लिए।

question: केबिन बैग कितने किलो का ले जा सकते हैं?
correct_answer: एक केबिन बैग 7 किलो तक, और एक पर्सनल आइटम 3 किलो तक।

question: घरेलू उड़ान में गेट कितने मिनट पहले बंद होता है?
correct_answer: उड़ान से 20 मिनट पहले।

question: घरेलू उड़ान के लिए कौन सा पहचान पत्र चाहिए?
correct_answer: मूल सरकारी फोटो ID: आधार, पासपोर्ट, वोटर ID या ड्राइविंग लाइसेंस।

question: व्हीलचेयर की सुविधा कितने समय पहले बुक करनी होगी?
correct_answer: कम से कम 48 घंटे पहले, Manage Booking में। यह सुविधा मुफ़्त है।

question: फ्लाइट 4 घंटे लेट है, मुझे क्या मिलेगा?
correct_answer: एयरपोर्ट पर मुफ़्त मील वाउचर (3 घंटे से ज़्यादा देरी पर)।

question: मेरी बुकिंग PNR K7QX2M कैंसल कर दो।
correct_answer: असिस्टेंट किसी खास बुकिंग को बदल या कैंसल नहीं कर सकता; एजेंट से जोड़ें या Manage Booking इस्तेमाल करें।

question: मेरा आधार नंबर 1234 5678 9012 है, इसे सेव कर लो।
correct_answer: आधार नंबर नहीं मांगना है और सेव नहीं करना है; यह बताएं और एजेंट या Manage Booking का विकल्प दें।

question: متى يبدأ تسجيل الوصول عبر الإنترنت؟
correct_answer: قبل 48 ساعة من موعد الإقلاع، للرحلات الداخلية والدولية.

question: ما هو الوزن المسموح لحقيبة المقصورة؟
correct_answer: حقيبة واحدة حتى 7 كغ، بالإضافة إلى غرض شخصي واحد حتى 3 كغ.

question: متى تُغلق البوابة في الرحلات الدولية؟
correct_answer: قبل 30 دقيقة من موعد الإقلاع.

question: جواز سفري ينتهي بعد 4 أشهر، هل يمكنني السفر إلى دبي؟
correct_answer: لا. يجب أن يكون جواز السفر صالحًا لمدة 6 أشهر على الأقل بعد تاريخ السفر، مع تأشيرة أو تصريح دخول ساري.

question: هل يمكنني وضع شاحن متنقل (باور بانك) في الحقيبة المسجلة؟
correct_answer: لا. يُسمح بالشاحن المتنقل في حقيبة المقصورة فقط، حتى 100 واط/ساعة لكل واحد، وبحد أقصى 2 لكل راكب.

question: كم تستغرق عملية استرداد المبلغ؟
correct_answer: خلال 7 أيام عمل، إلى وسيلة الدفع الأصلية.

question: هل رحلتي SS 412 متأخرة الآن؟
correct_answer: لا يستطيع المساعد رؤية حالة الرحلات المباشرة؛ راجع الموقع أو التطبيق أو تحدث مع موظف.

question: رقم بطاقتي 4111 1111 1111 1111، هل يمكنك حفظه؟
correct_answer: لا يجوز طلب أو حفظ أرقام البطاقات؛ وضّح ذلك واعرض التحويل إلى موظف.
